about: Model verdicts on source against tree for hse-l140 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: Each quoted sub-heading is joined to the end of the paragraph before it instead of heading the paragraph that follows.
findings.evidence: source: "'Employees whose health is at particular risk' 37 Under regulation 6(6)" / tree (para 36): "long, uninterrupted exposure. ‘Employees whose health is at particular risk’"

findings.problem: The margin labels 5(3)(a) to 5(3)(g) are kept as six notes in a row before paragraph 36, not beside the paragraphs they mark.
findings.evidence: source: "Guidance 5(3)(c)" beside paragraph 39 / tree: notes "5(3)(a)", "5(3)(b)", "5(3)(c)", "5(3)(d)", "5(3)(e)", "5(3)(g)" before paragraph 36

findings.problem: The heading above paragraph 102 is joined to the end of paragraph 101 as body text.
findings.evidence: tree: "is given in Appendix 2. The relationship between vibration magnitude, duration of exposure and daily vibration exposure (A(8) value)"

findings.problem: Three small sub-headings printed under the large heading "Calculating daily exposure" are placed directly under PART 2 as its siblings, so their paragraphs lose that parent.
findings.evidence: source: "Calculating daily exposure" (large) then "Sources of vibration magnitude", "Ready-reckoner", "The HSE calculator" (small) / tree: "PART 2 Management and control of risk from hand-arm vibration > Sources of vibration magnitude"

findings.problem: The one printed Table 3 is given twice: once as Table 3 and again as a second, unnumbered table with the same 13 rows and a title that is not printed on the page.
findings.evidence: source: "Table 3 Examples of alternative work processes to eliminate or reduce exposure to vibration" / tree: second table titled "Reduce exposure by good process control"

findings.problem: Table 3 sits under the heading "Reduce exposure by good process control", which is not printed on this page, while paragraph 123 that introduces it is under the earlier heading.
findings.evidence: tree: "Reduce exposure by good process control > Table 3" / tree para 123: "Eliminate vibration exposure by changing the work processes > Paragraph 123"

findings.problem: The footnote marker 21 is joined to the standard number, so it reads like part of the standard's number.
findings.evidence: source: "BS EN ISO 8041.²¹ Accelerometers" / tree: "BS EN ISO 8041.21 Accelerometers"
